paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: We compare error rate (one minus accuracy), computation cost, and memory usage across our approach and baselines when fine-tuning Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks. MTL-FT refers to first fine-tuning a shared LoRA on all the datasets, and then fine-tuning the low-rank adapter on each dataset, while Full FT refers to full fine-tuning of the entire model. Our approach boosts the test accuracy of QLoRA by 10\% on average, only incurring 8\% additional computation and 9 GB more memory. It performs on par with the best baseline with 45\% less FLOPs.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази стълбовидна диаграма представя стойностите на FLOPs (изчисления с плаваща запетая в секунда) за различни методи за настройка на езикови модели. Хоризонталната ос представлява категориите методи за настройка - "Full FT", "TAG", "LoRA", "MTL-FT", "QLoRA" и "Ours", разположени в произволен ред. Вертикалната ос показва FLOPs, етикетирана като "# FLOPs", със скала, логаритмична, варираща от 10<sup>18</sup> до 10<sup>20</sup>. Стълбовете показват стойностите на FLOPs за всеки метод. Стойността на стълба за "Full FT" е около 1.6 x 10<sup>19</sup>, докато стълбът за "TAG" е с приблизително 1.2 x 10<sup>19</sup>. Стълбовете за "LoRA" и "MTL-FT" са около 1.0 x 10<sup>19</sup> и 1.1 x 10<sup>19</sup>, съответно. Стълбът за "QLoRA" е приблизително 0.8 x 10<sup>19</sup>, а стълбът за "Ours" е маркиран със зелен цвят и има стойност около 0.7 x 10<sup>19</sup>.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the number of floating point operations (FLOPs) required by various fine-tuning methods. The horizontal axis displays the method labels: Full FT, TAG, LoRA, MTL-FT, QLoRA, and Ours, with "Ours" visually distinguished by a green bar, while the other bars are orange. The horizontal axis is labeled "TAG", "FT", "TAG", "LoRA", "MTL-FT", "QLoRA", and "Ours", and appears to be ordered alphabetically. The vertical axis represents the number of FLOPs, labeled “# FLOPs”, and uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 10<sup>18</sup> to 10<sup>20</sup>, with tick labels at intervals of 10<sup>19</sup>. The bar for Full FT reaches approximately 1.9 x 10<sup>20</sup> FLOPs, the tallest bar on the chart, while the bar for Ours reaches approximately 6 x 10<sup>18</sup> FLOPs, the shortest. The other bars have lengths of about 1.7 x 10<sup>20</sup> (TAG), 1.6 x 10<sup>20</sup> (LoRA), 1.5 x 10<sup>20</sup> (MTL-FT), and 1.1 x 10<sup>19</sup> (QLoRA). No bars are emphasized beyond the use of color.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm stellt die Anzahl der FLOPs für verschiedene Methoden dar, die beim Fine-Tuning von Sprachmodellen verwendet werden. Die horizontale Achse zeigt die Methoden – „Full FT“, „TAG“, „LoRA“, „MTL-FT“, „QLoRA“ und „Ours“ – in dieser Reihenfolge, wobei „Ours“ am weitesten rechts steht. Die vertikale Achse ist logarithmisch skaliert und beschriftet mit „# FLOPs“, mit Ticks, die in regelmäßigen Abständen von 10<sup>18</sup> bis 10<sup>20</sup> eingezeichnet sind. Die Balken sind alle goldfarben, mit Ausnahme des Balkens für „Ours“, der dunkelgrün ist. Der Balken für „Full FT“ ist der höchste und erreicht ungefähr 1,6 × 10<sup>20</sup> FLOPs. Der Balken für „TAG“ liegt bei etwa 1,3 × 10<sup>20</sup> FLOPs, der für „LoRA“ bei etwa 1,1 × 10<sup>20</sup> FLOPs und der für „MTL-FT“ bei etwa 9 × 10<sup>19</sup> FLOPs. Der Balken für „QLoRA“ ist niedriger und erreicht etwa 7 × 10<sup>19</sup> FLOPs, während der Balken für „Ours“ am niedrigsten ist und ungefähr 5 × 10<sup>19</sup> FLOPs erreicht.
